hero.title: Siargao, the quieter side
hero.subtitle: Pick when you can go and your budget. Here are spots most first-timers skip.

spots.title: Pacifico
spots.subtitle: Long quiet beach and uncrowded waves. Stay two nights instead of a day trip.

spots.title: Magpupungko rock pools
spots.subtitle: Go on a weekday morning at low tide. Check the tide table the night before.

spots.title: Sugba Lagoon by paddle board
spots.subtitle: Skip the jump platform crowd and paddle into the mangroves early.

note.title: Pick your season
note.body: September to November brings the biggest swell and the surf cup crowds at Cloud 9. For calm water, easy island hopping and cheaper rooms, March to June is the sweet spot.
note.author: From a Siargao local
